full_prompt_en: A hand-painted animation-style illustration looks up into a tightly packed crowd of people leaning toward something below the frame. Three younger figures form the foremost row: a dark-haired boy in blue at left, a black-haired girl in rust red at center, and a blond child in warm red at right. Behind them, faces of many ages and appearances rise in staggered rows, including white-haired elders, a bespectacled bald man, and a figure in a red head wrap. Nearly everyone looks downward toward the viewer, creating a shared visual pull without revealing the object of their attention. The space between heads is minimal; shoulders and hair overlap, and upper rows become smaller and more muted as they recede. Faces are simplified with clear eyes, small noses, and economical mouths, yet slight differences in posture and gaze make the group feel individually observed. Muted teal, slate, tan, cream, brown, and rust-red shapes are outlined with soft dark strokes. The paint surface has a faint grain and understated wash, avoiding glossy digital smoothness. Light is diffuse, allowing the front row to hold stronger color and contrast while the upper background figures settle into olive-gray shadow. There is almost no visible environment, so rhythm comes from repeated ovals, hairlines, and downward eye directions. The whole frame conveys collective curiosity and quiet tension through compressed composition and empathetic animated drawing.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅手绘动画风插画从下方望向紧密聚在一起、朝画框下方俯身的人群。三个较年轻的身影构成最前排：左边是穿蓝衣的深发男孩，中间是穿锈红色衣服的黑发女孩，右边是着暖红色的金发孩子。他们身后，不同年龄与面貌的脸在错落行列中升起，包括白发老人、戴眼镜的秃头男子和头裹红布的人。几乎所有人都朝观者下方看去，形成共同的视觉吸力，却没有揭示他们注视的对象。头部之间几乎没有空隙；肩膀与头发互相重叠，上方队列越远越小、颜色越淡。面孔由清楚的眼睛、小鼻子和节省的嘴部简化而成，但姿态与视线的轻微差别使群体依然像被逐一观察过。低饱和青绿、石板色、棕褐、奶油白、棕色与锈红色形体由柔和深线围住。颜料表面有淡淡颗粒与克制薄染，避免光滑的数字质感。光线漫射，让前排保留更强色彩与对比，上方背景人物则融入橄榄灰阴影。画面几乎看不见环境，因此节奏来自重复的椭圆、发际和向下的目光方向。整幅画通过压缩构图和富于同理心的动画绘制，传达集体好奇与安静紧张。
style_prompt_en: The hand-painted animation image packs overlapping rounded shapes into a close, upward-stacked composition with almost no visible setting. Clear dark contours and economical internal marks preserve readability even where forms touch. Foreground areas carry stronger rust, teal, slate, and warm cream notes; upper layers become smaller, grayer, and more densely interwoven. Diffuse light keeps shadows soft, with contrast concentrated along the lower focal band. Faces or comparable focal planes are simplified into flat warm shapes and a few exact accents rather than modeled photorealistically. Faint pigment grain and restrained wash texture soften the digital finish. Repeated ovals, tilted axes, and small eye-like points create a collective rhythm and shared direction. The whole frame feels observant and quietly tense through tight spacing, muted color, and gentle hand-drawn variation.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅手绘动画图像把重叠的圆润形体压进紧密、向上堆叠的构图，几乎不露出环境。清楚的深色轮廓和节省的内部笔迹即使在形体相触处也保留可读性。前景带有较强的锈色、青绿、石板色和暖奶油白色点，上层则更小、更灰，也更紧密交织。漫射光让阴影柔软，对比集中于下方焦点带。面孔或类似焦点平面被简化为平整暖色形状和少数准确重点，而不作照片般建模。淡淡颜料颗粒和克制的薄染肌理柔化数字完成感。重复椭圆、倾斜轴线和小小眼状重点形成共同节奏与一致方向。整幅画借紧密间距、低饱和色彩和温柔的手绘变化，显得观察细致且安静紧张。
